information_sources.decoder_visible_at: after byte 31 has been decoded and before byte 32 is predicted

information_sources.value_type: ordered integer coder counts with common scale C
information_sources.source_identity: exact count supplied by the authoritative parent to the arithmetic coder

information_sources.value_type: closed set of branch-dependent parent state
information_sources.decoder_visible_at: after ordinary parent processing of byte 31

information_sources.value_type: integer coder count p_u over scale C
information_sources.decoder_visible_at: before each second-half bit is coded

information_sources.value_type: integer coder count d_u over scale C
information_sources.decoder_visible_at: before each second-half bit is coded

prediction_boundary.variable: q_u integer coder count over frozen scale C
prediction_boundary.source_location: safe-fork:after both branch predictions and SAFE-MIX integer combination
prediction_boundary.before: parent count p_u, adapted count d_u, and pre-truth posterior state w_u are available
prediction_boundary.after: q_u is clipped and quantized exactly once and supplied unchanged to the arithmetic coder

update.equation: At byte 32, copy every branch-dependent parent state sigma_P to sigma_D and apply the frozen full admissible midpoint update only to sigma_D. For each bit u in bytes 32..63, compute parent count p_u and adapted count d_u, obtain coder count q_u=SAFE_MIX_V1(p_u,d_u,w_u), code/decode the bit with q_u, advance sigma_P only through ordinary parent transitions, advance sigma_D through adapted transitions, and update w_u only after the truth is decoder-visible. At byte 64, discard sigma_D, retain sigma_P exactly, and retain the global SAFE-MIX posterior.

lifecycle.activate: byte 32 after the complete first-half truth and ordinary parent state are synchronized
lifecycle.reset: discard adapted_expert_branch_state at byte 64; do not reset safe_mix_global_posterior
lifecycle.join: retain the authoritative parent state byte-for-byte and copy no adapted branch value into it

numeric_contract.format: parent arithmetic unchanged; full midpoint update inherits its frozen parent format; mixture uses gamma_safe_mix_v1 fixed integer format
numeric_contract.rounding: inherit each frozen dependency exactly; no additional conversion is permitted
numeric_contract.overflow: fail closed before coder output on any dependency overflow or marker condition
numeric_contract.accumulation_order: parent source order, frozen full-midpoint source order, then frozen SAFE-MIX integer operations

mixture.rule: gamma_safe_mix_v1 two-expert integer law over authoritative parent and bounded adapted expert
mixture.posterior_scope: one global causal posterior retained across 64-byte blocks
mixture.sleeping_behavior: adapted expert sleeps outside bytes 32 through 63; sleeping events do not reset or charge a new prior

controls.K: identical snapshot, fork, hashing, and sleeping bookkeeping with parent-identical expert and zero midpoint update; must equal P
controls.R: independent matched-norm random-direction midpoint update inside the same bounded fork and mixture
controls.S: frozen causal misalignment of first-half event associations with otherwise identical fork and mixture

ceilings.reject_only_futility_rule: At any sealed scope, stop only after the target-bearing M archive has irreversibly exceeded the dynamic package-aware archive ceiling; the partial result receives no compression verdict.
